_note: Texts the Mac app needs that core/desktop/design/strings.en.json doesn't have yet (the shared file is a copy of raven-core's and must stay identical to it). Every key starts with mac. and only adds a text: Strings.shared loads this file after strings.en.json and never lets it replace a shared key. Move each text into the shared file with raven-core, then delete it here (MacUXFixesTests fails while a key is in both).
mac.quit.running: The Raven background program keeps running while this computer is on and you stay logged in, so friends can still reach you and waiting messages keep trying.
mac.lock.locked.body: The Raven background program keeps running without its keys. It does not receive, read or send messages until you unlock.
mac.lock.locked.plainBody: While Raven is locked it does not receive, read or send messages. Unlock to use it again.
mac.lock.passphrase.note: Your passphrase goes only to the Raven background program on this computer.
mac.lock.confirm.does: Raven goes to sleep. It reads, receives and sends nothing until you wake it with your passphrase. Messages from friends wait safely on their side.
mac.lock.confirm.doesNoPassphrase: Raven goes to sleep. It reads, receives and sends nothing until you wake it. Messages from friends wait safely on their side.
mac.lock.confirm.doesNot: Lock does not protect against someone who uses this computer as you while Raven is unlocked, or against programs already running as you.
mac.lock.v2.body: Locking keeps the Raven background program running without its keys: it does not receive, read or send messages until you unlock.
mac.lock.notAvailable: Lock while running is not in this version of Raven yet.
mac.lock.notSupported: The Raven background program cannot lock now: it is not running, or it is an older version.
mac.lock.ready: Lock now keeps the Raven background program running without its keys: nothing is read or sent until you unlock.
mac.lock.passphrase.notInApp: Setting or changing a Raven passphrase is not in this app yet.
mac.lock.passphrase.body: Your Raven keys on this computer open only with your Raven passphrase. Unlocking asks for it.
mac.network.localOnly: Receiving on this computer only: friends on your network cannot reach you.
mac.network.process.app: Background program: running, started by this app
mac.settings.receive.body: To get messages, Raven keeps a small background program running that listens on your network. Only friends you add can send you anything.
mac.groups.remove.title: Remove {name} from {group}?
mac.groups.remove.body: {name} stops getting this group's messages and can't write to it. Messages so far stay on this computer.
mac.groups.remove.notFriend: {name} isn't your friend, so you can't add them back: only your friends can be added to a group.
mac.add.share.includeAddressNone: Include my network address. Anyone you send this to can see it.
mac.add.noAddress.notReceiving: Your card has no network address: Raven isn't receiving now. Your friend can still add you.
mac.add.noAddress.thisComputerOnly: Your card has no network address: Raven receives on this computer only (127.0.0.1), so friends on your network can't reach you.
mac.add.noAddress.noNetwork: Your card has no network address: this computer isn't on a network now.
mac.add.noAddress.other: Your card has no network address: Raven has none to share now.
mac.lock.plainBody: While Raven is locked it doesn't receive, read or send messages. Unlock to use it again.
